y-m-11-06.title: Siyaabaha loo qaybiyo 24 nacnac bacab
y-m-11-06.topic: Isku xidhka u dhexeeya tirada bacabka iyo tirada bac kasta ku jirta (marka wadarta la go'aamiyey)
y-m-11-06.goal: Hel xiriirka jadwalka sida tirada bac kasta ku jirta u isbeddesho marka tirada bacabku kordho, samee dhowr hab oo ku habboon shuruudaha, oo xukun in xaaladaha qaarkood ay suurtagal ahayn.
y-m-11-06.material:
Waxaad rabtaa inaad u qaybiso 24 nacnac bacab leh tiro isku mid ah bac kasta. Waxaad gelisaa nacnaca oo dhan, adigoon midna ka tagin. Eeg jadwalka. 
 Marka tirada bacabku tahay 2, waxaa jira 12 bac kasta; marka tirada bacabku tahay 3, waxaa jira 8 bac kasta; marka tirada bacabku tahay 4, waxaa jira 6 bac kasta.

y-m-11-06.prereq.1: Akhrinta sida laba qadar isu beddelaan jadwal

y-m-11-06.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad eegtay labada unug ee ugu horreeya oo keliya (12→8). Hubi haddii uu sidoo kale hoos u dhacay 4 unugga saddexaad (8→6).
y-m-11-06.s.s1.o.b: Haddii aad ku darto tirada bacabka iyo tirada nacnaca bac kasta ku jira, mar walba waxaad heshaa isla lambar
y-m-11-06.s.s1.r.b: Haddii aad ku darto labada lambar unug kasta, waxaad helaysaa 14, 11, 10. Unug unug hubi haddii wadarradu isku mid yihiin.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.o.c: Haddii aad ku dhufato tirada bacabka iyo tirada nacnaca bac kasta ku jira, mar walba waxaad heshaa 24
y-m-11-06.s.s1.r.c: Kani waa doorasho hubisay haddii qiimaha ka sameysmay labada lambar uu isku mid yahay saddexda unug.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.o.d: Tirada nacnaca bac kasta ku jira waa 6 jeer tirada bacabka
y-m-11-06.s.s1.r.d: Waa 6 jeer unugga koowaad oo keliya (2→12). Unugga labaad, hubi haddii 6 jeer tirada bacabka, 3, uu yahay 8.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.explain: Saddexda unug oo dhan wax-isku-dhufashadu waa 24: 2×12=24, 3×8=24, 4×6=24. Tani waa sababtoo ah waxaa jira 24 nacnac wadar ahaan. Wadarrada iyo tirooyinka hoos u dhacay waa kala duwan yihiin unug kasta.
y-m-11-06.s.s2.prompt: Hel kiisaska jadwalka ku jirin. Samee 2 hab oo kala duwan oo lagu geliyo 24-ka nacnac oo dhan adigoon midna ka tagin. Tirada bacabka a waa 5 ama ka badan, bac kasta na waa inuu qaadaa b nacnac, taasoo ah 2 ama ka badan.
y-m-11-06.s.s2.hint.0: Sida saddexda unug ee jadwalka, dooro tirada bacabka hal-hal oo hel imisa ayaa bac kasta ku jirta si loo sameeyo 24.

y-m-11-06.s.s2.var.b: Tirada nacnaca bac kasta ku jira
y-m-11-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Tirada bacabku waa tiro dabiici ah oo 5 ama ka badan, tirada nacnaca bac kasta ku jirtana waa tiro dabiici ah oo 2 ama ka badan.
y-m-11-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Ka dhig tirada bacabka 5 ama ka badan, tirada nacnaca bac kasta ku jirta na tiro dabiici ah oo 2 ama ka badan.
y-m-11-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Wadarta laga sameeyey tirada bacabka iyo tirada nacnaca bac kasta ku jira ma aha 24. Hubi xiriirka aad ka heshay jadwalka.
y-m-11-06.s.s2.explain: Hababka ku habboon shuruudaha waa 6 bac oo 4 mid kasta, 8 bac oo 3 mid kasta, iyo 12 bac oo 2 mid kasta. 4 bac oo 6 mid kasta wuxuu leeyahay tirada bacabka ka yar 5, 24 bac oo 1 mid kasta na ma buuxiyo shuruudda ah bac kasta inuu lahaado 2 ama ka badan. y-m-11-06.s.s3.r.b: 5 bac oo 4 mid kasta waa 20. Hubi haddii 24-ka nacnac oo dhan la geliyey.

y-m-11-06.s.s3.o.d: Waxay ku xidhan tahay imisa ayaa bac kasta galaya, sidaas darteed ma ogaan karo
y-m-11-06.s.s3.r.d: Ma tijaabin lambarrada suurtagalka ah hal-hal. Beddel lambarka 1, 2, 3, … oo qor wadarta.
y-m-11-06.s.s3.explain: Haddii aad geliso 4 5 bac kasta, waa 20, haddii aad geliso 5 na, waa 25, sidaas darteed midna si sax ah ma la mid yahay 24. Haddii aad u qaybiso 24 si siman 5 bac, ma qaybsamo si siman tiro dabiici ah, sidaas darteed suurtagal ma aha.

y-m-11-01.title: Tiro noocee ah ayaa raacda 2, 4, 8?
y-m-11-01.topic: Xeerarka qaababka tirooyinka: go'aaminta in bilowga isku mid ah uu go'aamiyo tirada xigta oo keliya
y-m-11-01.goal: Fahan in dhawr tiro ee ugu horreeya qaab ay laga yaabo inaanay go'aamin xeerka oo keliya, samee tirooyin xiga adigoo isticmaalaya xeerar kala duwan, oo sheeg waxa kale oo aad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato.
y-m-11-01.material: Jihu wuxuu saf ku dhigay kaararka tirooyinka. Saddexda ugu horreeya waa 2, 4, 8. Jihu wuxuu yidhi, “Kaarka xiga waa hubaal 16!” Dhammaan tirooyinka kaararka ku yaal waa tirooyin dabiici ah, waxaana jira xeer go'aamiya tirada xigta tirada ka horraysa.

y-m-11-01.s.s1.r.a: Waa run in 2, 4, 8 ay ku habboon yihiin xeerka labanlaabidda. Laakiin weli ma tijaabin in uu jiro xeer kale oo sameeya saddexda tiro isku midka ah.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.o.b: Waxaad ogaan kartaa in uu yahay 16 kaliya kadib markaad hubiso in uu jiro xeer kale oo sameeya 2, 4, 8
y-m-11-01.s.s1.r.b: Tani waa fikirka ah in aan la joojin kadib helitaanka hal xeer, laakiin la tijaabiyo in xeer kale uu sameeyo isla qaabka tirooyinka.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.o.c: Tirooyinku way sii weynaadaan, markaa kaarka xiga wuxuu noqon karaa wax kasta oo ka weyn 8
y-m-11-01.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad isticmaashay oo keliya xaqiiqda ah inay sii weynaato, mana eegin intay le'eg tahay mar kasta. Sidee ka eegidda xiriirka u dhexeeya tirooyinka deriska ah?
y-m-11-01.s.s1.o.d: Saddex kaarar oo keliya ayaa jira, markaa ma odhan karno xeer ayaa jira, mana ogaan karno tirada xigta
y-m-11-01.s.s1.r.d: Ma isticmaalin shuruudda 'xeer ayaa jira'. Haddii xeer jiro, waxaad ka raadin kartaa xeerarka suurtagalka ah saddexda kaarar.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.explain: 2, 4, 8 waxaa lagu sameyn karaa xeerka 'labanlaab tirada ka horraysa', iyo sidoo kale xeerka 'tirada lagu daro tirada ka horraysa waxay kortaa 2, sida 2, 4'. Tirada xigta waxay ku kala duwan tahay xeerka, markaa way adag tahay in la yiraahdo waa 16 saddexda kaarar oo keliya.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.prompt: Aan tijaabinno hadalka Jihu. Samee 2 tiro oo kala duwan oo laga yaabo inay raacaan 2, 4, 8. Tirada xigta waa inay raacdaa mid ka mid ah xeerarkan: (가) xeer mar kasta ku dhufta tirada ka horraysa tiro jeer ah, ama (나) xeer tirada lagu daro tirada ka horraysa ay kordho isla cadad mar kasta.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore hel 'immisa jeer' iyo 'intee la raray' marka laga gudbo 2 ilaa 4 iyo 4 ilaa 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qor tirada aad helayso marka aad xeer kasta ku dabaqdo 8 mar kale.

y-m-11-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ka dhig tirada xigta tiro dabiici ah oo ka weyn 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Waa tiro raacaysa mid ka mid ah labada xeer.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Tirada kuma imaanayso 2, 4, 8 kadib xeerka (가) ama xeerka (나). Mid kasta oo labada xeer ah ku dabaq 8 hal mar.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.explain: Xeerka (가), labanlaabidda, waa 16, kaasoo ah 8 la labanlaabay. Xeerka (나), halka tirada lagu daray ay kortay 2 sida 2, 4, 6, waa 8+6=14. Isla saddexda tiro, tirada xigta way kala duwanaan kartaa.

y-m-11-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kadib, qor sida tirada lagu daro isu beddesho oo ku dar 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.r.a: Weli waxaad isticmaalaysaa xeerka sii wadidda adigoo labanlaabaya tirada ka horraysa. Xeerka hadda laguu sheegay wuxuu ku saabsan yahay tirada lagu daray.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad ku haysay tirada lagu daray 4. Xeerka laguu sheegay, tirada lagu daray mar kasta way kala duwan tahay.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.r.c: Tani waa fikirka sii wadidda tirooyinka lagu daray sida 2, 4, 6.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.r.d: Waxaad ku dartay 2 8. Sii wad socodka halkaas oo tirada lagu daray ay ka kortay 2 ilaa 4.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.explain: Marka xeerka lagu bixiyo erayo, tirada xigta waa go'an hal keliya. Tirooyinka lagu daray waa 2, 4, 6, markaa 8+6=14.
